desc: The Original Crunch. Nature Valley Crunchy Oats 'n Dark Chocolate Granola Bars are a tasty snack made with whole grain oats and dark chocolate pieces. A portable snack that's perfect for the pantry, lunch box, and hiking trail. There are no artificial flavors, colors, or high fructose corn syrup, and these snack bars contain 21g of whole grain per serving (at least 48g recommended daily). It's perfect for snack time or as an on the go treat everyone in your household can enjoy. At Nature Valley, we believe that what you put in is what you get out. So wherever the moment takes you and your family, you can rely on our great tasting snacks to help keep you going. Contains one regular cardboard box of Nature Valley Crunchy Granola Bars, Oats 'n Dark Chocolate, 12 Bars, 8.94 oz (6 pouches); perfect for instant snacking.
features:
QUALITY INGREDIENTS: Made with hearty whole grain oats; These bars contain no artificial flavors, artificial colors, or high fructose corn syrup

WHOLE GRAIN: Wholesome snacks with 21g of whole grain per serving (at least 48g recommended daily)

CRUNCHY GRANOLA BARS: Nature Valley Crunchy Oats 'n Dark Chocolate Granola Bars combine delicious whole grain oats with dark chocolate pieces for a delectable snack

PERFECTLY PORTABLE: Easy bars for an on the go treat the entire family will enjoy; Slip one into a backpack or lunch box for a wholesome bite any time

CONTAINS: One regular cardboard box of Nature Valley Crunchy Granola Bars, Oats 'n Dark Chocolate, 12 Ct, 8.94 oz (6 pouches); Perfect for instant snacking
